title: Aurora telemetry batch envelope
description: One uplink message from a single cold-chain device: a batch of readings with a device-generated idempotency key. This is the payload published on aurora/v1/clinic/{clinic_id}/device/{device_id}/telemetry and posted to the HTTP batch endpoint. The device repo owns this schema; the API repo vendors it and validates every inbound message against it.

v.description: Payload schema version. The server accepts the current version (2) and the previous one (1), so device and server can be deployed independently. v2 adds the optional battery_pct field to a reading.

device_id.description: The device's stable id (a UUID string on the API side).

idempotency_key.description: SHA-256 over the batch's rows; identical across retries of the same rows so the server can drop a duplicate batch.

sequence.description: The device's monotonic reading number (its buffer row id). (device_id, sequence) is the server's idempotency key for a single reading.

measured_at.description: The device clock at the moment of the reading, ISO-8601 UTC.

battery_pct.description: Added in v2; absent in v1 payloads.
